activity_summary: You told Garnish the morning was not a reading, and he copied nothing. You tried the street only as far as the first anger, then read two lines of Mab yourself. Nick waited, and did not speak the girl. Kemp was told to keep the napkin until the room would not clear.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Refused a fair copy, and read the two lines.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Heard the street hold, and saw the alderman's finger before the dream.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Asked which pages, and kept the napkin for later.

entities.name: Nick Sorrell
entities.context: Waited, and did not speak her.

entities.name: Thomas Pope
entities.context: Asked for the street, and called two lines a thin breakfast.

entities.name: Abel Garnish
entities.context: Brought ink, and was told to copy nothing.

facets.activity: Tried the street to the first anger and read two lines of Mab

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: In shape no bigger then an Agot stone
